issue_scope: Partial Browser #15/#8; public Journal failure/cancellation boundary only
verified_behavior: Fixed public Denied/Cancelled errors do not retain upstream arguments, notes, cause/context or original callback traceback.
Active caller exception context is cleared before the fixed public exception is rethrown.
Ordinary accepted/lost submit failures and unusable observations retain unknown; cancellation never becomes a normal unknown return.
Unknown reservation survives errors after real COMMIT; fresh processes never resubmit that operation.
Readback failure after real COMMIT may retain a terminal stored result; failed return is not rollback proof.
Rollback failure poisons the instance and attempts close once; later calls neither invoke callbacks nor retry an uncertain close.
Ordinary cleanup errors do not mask cancellation, including model, read-only and writer admission connections.
Nested dispatch/reconcile/close deny before altering the outer connection transaction.
